# GREEN DISPLAY

> GREEN DISPLAY (绿展) is a one-stop Chinese manufacturer of metal display racks, supermarket shelving, retail fixtures, acrylic showcases and custom shop fittings for B2B clients. Founded 2014, ISO-certified, exporting to 30+ countries from a 12,000 m² factory in Zhangjiagang, Jiangsu, China.

GREEN DISPLAY supplies brand retailers, chain stores, distributors and shop-fitting contractors worldwide. The company provides OEM/ODM manufacturing, free 3D store layout design, and full-service custom fixture projects — from materials (metal, wood, acrylic, glass) and finishes (powder coating, chrome, anodizing, RAL colors) to knock-down (KD) flat-pack logistics. Key differentiators: eco-friendly materials and recycled metal, German KRRASS CNC machinery, and one-stop project management.

## Product Categories
- Metal display racks and stands
- Supermarket shelving and gondola units
- Retail fixtures (garment racks, cosmetic, electronics, hardware displays)
- Acrylic showcases and display cases
- Display accessories (hooks, label holders, lighting, wire baskets)
- Store furniture (checkout counters, display tables, fitting rooms)
- Custom shop fitting projects

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2014
- Factory: 12,000+ m², Zhangjiagang, Jiangsu, China
- Export markets: 30+ countries (Europe, North America, South America, Middle East, Southeast Asia)
- Certifications: ISO 9001
- Languages served: English, Spanish, Arabic, Chinese
- MOQ: from 50–100 units (standard accessories); negotiable for custom projects
- Lead time: 15–25 days (standard) / 30–45 days (custom)
